data.excerpt: ### Icon The icon is the small picture displayed to the left of decision's or category's name. Icons use sprites, defined in any `/Hearts of Iron IV/interface/*.gfx` file, by default in `decisions.gfx`. Within a decision or a category, it is set with `icon = icon_name`.
